line: I said no, go take care of you
He did, now look who's wanting who
He asked me out with daisies, shy
I liked him, I won't lie
A pizza stain, he looked his worst
I said, take care of you first
He cut his hair, he shaved his chin
The hoodies went in the bin
A box came with a navy knit
He walked out tall in it
I saw him from the tram and froze
I want him now, heaven knows
My phone's full of names I barely know
Girls ask where I shop: Moderno Milano
Her name lights up my phone; my turn to decide
I like you, but someone's by my side
I asked for one more try
He's with someone, he didn't lie
I pull my coat on, slow
I had him first, I let him go
Now look who's wanting who
Moderno Milano
